title: hooks/hooks.json
description: The canonical hook registry: each event maps to hook groups, and each group to the commands it runs, in Claude Code's hook format.
$comment: The hook-registry check in stratarc/validate.py (hook_registry_problems) is the standard library equivalent of this schema and runs in the gate before every sync, check and diff; tests/test_validate.py holds the two in agreement over every fixture. Event names are the canonical events every adapter declares, read by that check from this file; a sync refuses a runtime that does not map an event the registry uses. Hook and group objects stay open because adapters pass unknown keys through. type is fixed to command and timeout to a positive number, which every adapter assumes.

matcher.description: Tool name pattern the group applies to; absent means every tool.

timeout.description: Seconds; adapters convert it to the runtime's own unit.
